release_notes: The Feedback & Support page gains a Partners block: a themed full-width card under the contact grid listing partner services as linked logo tiles — Pay2.House (virtual cards for Facebook, Google and TikTok Ads spend) and GroupBuySEO (group-buy access to Ahrefs, Semrush, ChatGPT Plus and more) to start with. The block is data-driven, so a new partner is one SVG in frontend/public/partners/, one entry in the partners array and four locale strings. The white-on-transparent Pay2.House wordmark sits on a dark chip so it survives every theme, the global link-hover underline is suppressed inside the tiles, and the feedback.partners* strings ship in all seven locales.
